item.title: AI Crash Course: Hallucinations
item.content:encoded: While we can’t eliminate hallucinations entirely, there are still things we can do to reduce the chances of hallucinations showing up in our model’s responses.

item.title: How to Organize Minimal APIs
item.content:encoded: Minimal APIs arrived with .NET 6 and now, in Version 10, are already part of the daily routine for many developers. In this post, we'll explore best practices for organizing your Minimal APIs and see how Carter can help make them even cleaner, more modular and more elegant.

item.title: Guide to Creating an Angular-based Micro-frontend Application Using Native Federation
item.content:encoded: Micro-frontends break a large frontend application into smaller, independent components. Here’s how to do this in Angular with Native Federation.

item.title: 5 UX Tips for .NET MAUI Developers
item.content:encoded: Following these five UX tips as a .NET MAUI developer can help keep your app user-friendly and polished.

item.title: How to Build a NestJS AI Chatbot with Google Gemini
item.content:encoded: In this post, we will build a real-time FAQ chatbot for a tax management SaaS using Gemini 2.5 Flash and NestJS with Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream replies to the user. You'll learn how to set up Gemini and understand how context caching works.

item.title: Understanding the Architecture of a Prompt
item.content:encoded: Learn what prompt engineering is and how to create prompts so AI is best able to help you.

item.title: Coding Azure 22: Adding Configuration Information to an App Configuration Service
item.content:encoded: With the App Configuration service we built last time, we can now apply settings and configuration information. Here’s a look at how to do that and what the options are.

item.title: Spreadsheet Analysis with Telerik Document Processing Libraries Agentic Tools
item.content:encoded: Agentic workflows provide dynamic ways to interact with and analyze documents. The Telerik Document Processing Libraries now have these AI tools ready to use!

item.title: Customizing the New ReconnectModal Component in Blazor 10
item.content:encoded: Learn how to customize the reconnection modal dialog for users of your Blazor app with the ReconnectionModal component, introduced in .NET 10.

item.title: An Introduction to TanStack DB: A Reactive Data Layer for Modern Web Applications
item.content:encoded: In this article, we will build a to-do app to see TanStack DB in action. We’ll cover how to set up collections, what “live queries” are, and why “differential dataflow” makes it so fast. We'll also cover when to use TanStack DB and when TanStack Query alone is enough.

item.title: .NET 10: Secondary Toolbar Items for iOS and macOS in .NET MAUI
item.content:encoded: As of .NET 10, iOS and macOS support secondary toolbar items, which are found in overflow menus and make a .NET MAUI app feel more native to the Apple user experience.

item.title: Singleton or Not? Understanding Angular Services the Right Way
item.content:encoded: Angular services are singleton and tree-shakeable by default, but there are some important catches to these states. Let’s understand what those are.

item.title: Design Principles Unpacked, No. 1: Alignment
item.content:encoded: Alignment is more than a design principle. It’s a way of positioning yourself on purpose.

item.title: How to Identify Technologies Worth Exploring
item.content:encoded: One senior developer shares his perspective on one of the biggest challenges facing technology professionals today: how to know what tech trends really matter.

item.title: AI Crash Course: Tokens, Prediction and Temperature
item.content:encoded: We often describe AI models as “thinking,” but what is actually happening when an AI model “thinks”? When it’s drafting a response to us, how does it know what to say?
